import copy
from collections.abc import Callable
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, contextmanager, nullcontext  # ←独占 contextmanager import
from dataclasses import replace                                   # ←独占 replace import
from functools import partial
from typing import Any, cast
...
import vllm.distributed.parallel_state as _ps                    # ←独占 _ps alias import
from vllm.config import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode, ...      # ←独占 CompilationMode import
...
@contextmanager
def patch_tensor_parallel_group(tp_group):                        # ← 第1个：TP组临时替换（33行）
    """Temporarily swap the global TP group for draft-model spec decode."""
    old_tp_group = _ps.get_tp_group()
    _ps._TP_STATE_PATCHED = True
    _ps._TP = tp_group
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        _ps._TP_STATE_PATCHED = False
        _ps._TP = old_tp_group

@contextmanager
def _maybe_eager_context(vllm_config):                            # ← 第2个：切CompilationMode.NONE防fx-graph（23行）
    """TODO: Remove it when the bug of fx-graph is solved"""
    target_compilation_config = vllm_config.compilation_config
    draft_compilation_config = replace(target_compilation_config, mode=CompilationMode.NONE)
    draft_compilation_config.static_forward_context = target_compilation_config.static_forward_context
    draft_compilation_config.static_all_moe_layers = target_compilation_config.static_all_moe_layers
    vllm_config.compilation_config = draft_compilation_config
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        vllm_config.compilation_config = target_compilation_config

@contextmanager
def _disable_flash_comm_v1_context():                             # ← 第3个：MarkovHead关SP flash_comm（本次修复的15行）
    """sp should be disabled when running MarkovHead"""
    forward_context = get_forward_context()                       # ←这里用了 get_forward_context
    _raw_flash_comm_v1 = forward_context.flash_comm_v1_enabled
    try:
        forward_context.flash_comm_v1_enabled = False
        yield
    finally:
        forward_context.flash_comm_v1_enabled = _raw_flash_comm_v1
